youtube_description:
Experiment with forces, motion, magnetism, and conductivity using the Arduino Science Kit Physics Lab. 

The kit enables students to make their own hypotheses like real scientists, then check their assumptions, and log data thanks to Google’s Science Journal — a digital notebook for conducting and documenting science experiments in real-time using the smart capabilities of mobile devices. No coding experience required! 

🔬👨🏽‍🔬 https://store.arduino.cc/physics-lab?utm_source=YouTube%20Videos&utm_medium=youtube&utm_campaign=science_kit&utm_content=Science_kit_videos 

⚠️ Google Science Journal is now Arduino Science Journal! 

📲 Download the brand new Arduino Science Journal app on your Android, iOS, and Chromebook devices: http://sj.arduino.cc/ 

📦 Trays powered by Gratnells: https://www.gratnells.com/trays
